method: Production native meter source replayed through ordinary frame/native-method ownership mocks. Exact FluxWindowFrame order: old Meter onHide before activeTab change; native UpdateShownState inserted while old tab identity remains Meter. Eight mixed/threat-only, normal/gamepad, Always/Hidden configurations;500 cycles each. Five fresh-process alternating original/candidate runs. No warm-up beyond fixture creation and timer draining. CPU, allocation bytes, native resource objects, FPS, taint, secrets and pixel parity are not measured. Wall time includes assertions and differing resource work, not native latency. No game input/settings changes.
